note: Default classification rules for plugin items. Copy to config/warehouse/custom_item_rules.json (or the shared folder) to override; later files win by rule id. Match fields are case-insensitive regexes and all given fields must match. family: literal, $base (base item family such as the colour or wood type) or $pack (plugin pack prefix).

rules.note: ExecutableItems infinite glass and concrete, filed by colour next to the other infinite blocks.
Anything calling itself infinite, unlimited or endless.
Block cyclers (slab/stair/colour cyclers) behave like infinite blocks.
